orchestrator_escalated.finding: dialectic-6 + width-4 (major, same gap) — the concentration/inequality time series the report itself licenses and then never uses
orchestrator_escalated.issue: Section 2B rules that only two comparison classes survive — within-instrument time series with a constant denominator, and dimensionless shape statistics. The corpus holds exactly that artefact and the report cites none of it: El Sanyoura & Anderson (complete Patreon transaction record, Jun 2013 - Dec 2020, within-topic Gini 0.30 to 0.60, cross-topic 0.80 to 0.72), Zhao's VTuber between-creator Gini 0.60 to 0.75 (2018-2023), and the Strauss Pareto-alpha series across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and Twitch (n=104,719, 2018-2024), with the counter-cut that every Patreon earnings decile grew in absolute terms.
orchestrator_escalated.why_escalated: It needs a new paragraph of roughly four sentences plus a table row, which is regeneration scale rather than a surgical hunk, and there is no word offset left at the ceiling. It is also the highest-value remaining improvement in the set: it would turn a stipulated methodological rule into a demonstrated one, and it is the only place a pre-committed reconciliation (Houssard's elite-tier flux versus the widening across-population distribution measure different things and are compatible) sits unstated. Resolving it requires an orchestrator decision about length, not a patcher edit.
